# Recommendation: a proposal tool for the studio

## Decision
Recommended vendor: Linnet Proposals
It has the highest weighted total: templates with price tables and signatures included.

## Runner-up
Harrowgate Docs. It would be the better choice if an editable export or the lower price matters more than signatures.

## Knock-outs
None.

## Score table
| vendor | CR-01 | CR-02 | CR-03 | total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Harrowgate Docs | 2 | 2 | 3 | 230.00 |
| Linnet Proposals | 3 | 2 | 2 | 240.00 |

## Cost
| vendor | price (dated) | cost over 24 months |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Harrowgate Docs | 39.00 USD per seat per month, as quoted by the vendor on 2026-11-04 | 936.00 USD |
| Linnet Proposals | 480.00 USD per seat per month, as quoted by the vendor on 2026-11-05 | 11520.00 USD |

## Risks
- Lock-in: proposals live in the vendor's system; exports are PDF only for Linnet Proposals.
- Data export: PDF only for Linnet Proposals; PDF or Word for Harrowgate Docs.
- Contract term: monthly, as quoted.
- Price rises: the quoted price can change at renewal.

## What to confirm
- Whether an editable export exists (VQ-02).

## Conflicts statement
- Linnet Proposals: referral fee (stated by Robin on 2026-11-03)
- partner programme: a vendor's partner programme pays me a referral fee for each customer I refer (stated by Robin on 2026-11-02)
- The referral fee is 15% of the first year, stated at my choice.
